+from typing import Annotated
+
+
+import pytest
+
+
+from fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, UploadFile, params
+
+
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+
+from inline_snapshot import snapshot
+
+
+from pydantic import AliasChoices, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
+
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+@app.post("/required-bytes")
+def read_required_bytes(
+    file: Annotated[bytes | None, File()],
+    files: Annotated[list[bytes] | None, File()],
+):
+    assert file is not None
+    assert files is not None
+    return {"file": len(file), "files": [len(value) for value in files]}
+
+
+@app.post("/required-uploadfile")
+def read_required_uploadfile(
+    file: Annotated[UploadFile | None, File()],
+    files: Annotated[list[UploadFile] | None, File()],
+):
+    assert file is not None
+    assert files is not None
+    return {"file": file.size, "files": [value.size for value in files]}
+
+
+@app.post("/optional-bytes")
+def read_optional_bytes(
+    file: Annotated[bytes | None, File()] = None,
+    files: Annotated[list[bytes] | None, File()] = None,
+):
+    return {
+        "file": len(file) if file is not None else None,
+        "files": [len(value) for value in files] if files is not None else None,
+    }
+
+
+@app.post("/optional-uploadfile")
+def read_optional_uploadfile(
+    file: Annotated[UploadFile | None, File()] = None,
+    files: Annotated[list[UploadFile] | None, File()] = None,
+):
+    return {
+        "file": file.size if file is not None else None,
+        "files": [value.size for value in files] if files is not None else None,
+    }
+
+
+@app.post("/bytes-defaults")
+def read_bytes_defaults(
+    *,
+    file: Annotated[bytes | None, File()] = b"default",
+    files: Annotated[list[bytes] | None, File(default_factory=lambda: [b"default"])],
+):
+    assert file is not None
+    assert files is not None
+    return {"file": len(file), "files": [len(value) for value in files]}
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+EMPTY_FILE_FORM = (
+    b"--boundary\r\n"
+    b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename=""\r\n'
+    b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+    b"\r\n--boundary\r\n"
+    b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="files"; filename=""\r\n'
+    b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+    b"\r\n--boundary--\r\n"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/required-bytes", "/required-uploadfile"])
+def test_file_list_ignores_unselected_inputs(path):
+    response = client.post(
+        path,
+        content=(
+            b"--boundary\r\n"
+            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="empty.txt"\r\n'
+            b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+            b"\r\n--boundary\r\n"
+            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="files"; filename="first.txt"\r\n'
+            b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+            b"\r\n--boundary\r\n"
+            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="files"; filename=""\r\n'
+            b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+            b"\r\n--boundary\r\n"
+            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="files"; filename="last.txt"\r\n'
+            b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+            b"hello\r\n--boundary--\r\n"
+        ),
+        headers={"content-type": "multipart/form-data; boundary=boundary"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"file": 0, "files": [0, 5]}
+
+
+def test_unselected_file_alias_choices_use_the_next_alias():
+    app = FastAPI()
+
+    @app.post("/")
+    def read_file(
+        file: Annotated[
+            bytes,
+            File(alias="legacy", validation_alias=AliasChoices("file", "selected")),
+        ],
+    ):
+        return file.decode()
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.post(
+        "/",
+        content=(
+            b"--boundary\r\n"
+            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename=""\r\n'
+            b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+            b"\r\n--boundary\r\n"
+            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="selected"; filename="hello.txt"\r\n'
+            b"Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n"
+            b"hello\r\n--boundary--\r\n"
+        ),
+        headers={"content-type": "multipart/form-data; boundary=boundary"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == "hello"
+
+    response = client.post(
+        "/",
+        content=EMPTY_FILE_FORM,
+        headers={"content-type": "multipart/form-data; boundary=boundary"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+    assert [(error["type"], error["loc"]) for error in response.json()["detail"]] == [
+        ("missing", ["body", "file"]),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_model_files_can_share_an_unused_alias_choice():
+    app = FastAPI()
+
+    class FileModel(BaseModel):
+        files: Annotated[
+            list[UploadFile], Field(validation_alias=AliasChoices("files", "legacy"))
+        ]
+        file: Annotated[
+            UploadFile, Field(validation_alias=AliasChoices("file", "legacy"))
+        ]
+
+    @app.post("/")
+    def read_form(data: Annotated[FileModel, Form()]):
+        return {
+            "files": [file.filename for file in data.files],
+            "file": data.file.filename,
+        }
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.post(
+        "/",
+        files=[
+            ("legacy", ("one.txt", b"one")),
+            ("legacy", ("two.txt", b"two")),
+            ("file", ("hello.txt", b"hello")),
+        ],
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"files": ["one.txt", "two.txt"], "file": "hello.txt"}
+

+from typing import Annotated
+
+
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+
+import pytest
+
+
+from fastapi import Body, FastAPI, Form
+
+
+from fastapi._compat import PYDANTIC_VERSION_MINOR_TUPLE
+
+
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+
+from pydantic import (
+    AfterValidator,
+    AliasChoices,
+    AliasPath,
+    BaseModel,
+    ConfigDict,
+    Field,
+    ValidationError,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("encoding", ["urlencoded", "multipart"])
+def test_form_list_alias_choices_error_uses_selected_alias(encoding):
+    app = FastAPI()
+
+    @app.post("/")
+    def read_form(
+        values: Annotated[
+            list[int],
+            Form(alias="legacy", validation_alias=AliasChoices("first", "second")),
+        ],
+    ):
+        return values
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    if encoding == "urlencoded":
+        response = client.post("/", data={"second": ["1", "2"]})
+    else:
+        response = client.post(
+            "/", files=[("second", (None, "1")), ("second", (None, "2"))]
+        )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == [1, 2]
+
+    if encoding == "urlencoded":
+        response = client.post("/", data={"second": ["1", "invalid"], "legacy": "3"})
+    else:
+        response = client.post(
+            "/",
+            files=[
+                ("second", (None, "1")),
+                ("second", (None, "invalid")),
+                ("legacy", (None, "3")),
+            ],
+        )
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+    assert response.json() == {
+        "detail": [
+            {
+                "type": "int_parsing",
+                "loc": ["body", "second", 1],
+                "msg": "Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer",
+                "input": "invalid",
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("encoding", ["urlencoded", "multipart"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("unused", ["unused", ""])
+def test_unused_form_alias_choice_keeps_extra_value_shape(encoding, unused):
+    app = FastAPI()
+
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")
+        names: Annotated[
+            list[str], Field(validation_alias=AliasChoices("names", "legacy-names"))
+        ]
+        text: Annotated[
+            str, Field(validation_alias=AliasChoices("text", "legacy-text"))
+        ]
+
+    @app.post("/")
+    def read_model(params: Annotated[Model, Form()]):
+        return params
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    if encoding == "urlencoded":
+        response = client.post(
+            "/",
+            data={
+                "names": ["one", "two"],
+                "text": "hello",
+                "legacy-names": unused,
+                "legacy-text": ["", "unused"],
+            },
+        )
+    else:
+        response = client.post(
+            "/",
+            files=[
+                ("names", (None, "one")),
+                ("names", (None, "two")),
+                ("text", (None, "hello")),
+                ("legacy-names", (None, unused)),
+                ("legacy-text", (None, "")),
+                ("legacy-text", (None, "unused")),
+            ],
+        )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {
+        "names": ["one", "two"],
+        "text": "hello",
+        "legacy-names": unused,
+        "legacy-text": ["", "unused"],
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/parameter", "/model"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "data,expected",
+    [
+        pytest.param({"value": "on"}, True, id="checked"),
+        pytest.param({}, False, id="unchecked"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_required_nullable_checkbox(path, data, expected):
+    app = FastAPI()
+
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        value: bool | None
+
+    @app.post("/parameter")
+    def read_parameter(value: Annotated[bool | None, Form()]):
+        return {"value": value}
+
+    @app.post("/model")
+    def read_model(params: Annotated[Model, Form()]):
+        return params.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.post(path, data=data)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"value": expected}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["/parameter", "/model"])
+def test_checkbox_alias_choices_preserve_validation_precedence(path):
+    app = FastAPI()
+
+    class Model(BaseModel):
+        value: Annotated[
+            bool,
+            Field(alias="legacy", validation_alias=AliasChoices("enabled", "checkbox")),
+        ]
+
+    @app.post("/parameter")
+    def read_parameter(
+        value: Annotated[
+            bool,
+            Form(alias="legacy", validation_alias=AliasChoices("enabled", "checkbox")),
+        ],
+    ):
+        return {"value": value}
+
+    @app.post("/model")
+    def read_model(params: Annotated[Model, Form()]):
+        return params.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.post(
+        path, data={"enabled": "on", "checkbox": "invalid", "legacy": "invalid"}
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"value": True}
+
+    response = client.post(path, data={"enabled": "", "legacy": "on"})
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+
+    response = client.post(path, data={"enabled": "invalid", "checkbox": "on"})
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+    assert response.json() == {
+        "detail": [
+            {
+                "type": "bool_parsing",
+                "loc": ["body", "enabled"],
+                "msg": "Input should be a valid boolean, unable to interpret input",
+                "input": "invalid",
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
